name: Consent Client Baseline
description: Client baseline that starts by validating the consent proof and scope, then runs the username footprint.

inputs.name: username
inputs.label: Username (with consent or a documented case basis)

legal_notes: Applies to verified self-audits and consent-based engagements. Results are leads, not facts; nothing is verified automatically. Every run re-checks the subject's authorization, and revoking it switches the schedule off.
example_output: A de-duplicated dataset saved as evidence, with every finding linked to its source response.
capability_gaps: The workflow cannot validate a signed document: proof checking is a person's step in the Authorization panel.
Steps marked as review are carried out by a person in the Target Profile screens; the automation does not perform them.

config.prompt: Open Target profile > Authorization. Verify the signed proof is attached as evidence, names the identities and purposes, and has an end date. A checkbox is not proof.
Review each account with the client where possible; record the client's confirmation as an attestation.
